title: Menuverse
summary: An AI-assisted insurance policy flow that turns a structured vehicle questionnaire into a personalised quote and paperless purchase journey.
challenge: The manual agent-assisted process introduced unnecessary steps between answering policy questions and receiving a quote.
solution: Built a smooth multi-step questionnaire in React.js.
Implemented policy logic and pricing rules in Node.js.
Used AI-assisted logic to analyse responses and generate personalised quotes.
Added quote review, cart and digital-signature steps.
Stored policy configuration, responses and transaction records in MySQL.
outcomes: Quote generation became 60% faster than the manual process it replaced.
Created a fully paperless insurance purchase flow.
